src.label: USDA APHIS — pet travel from the United States to Malaysia (relaying Malaysian rules)

head: Dogs and cats need a MAQIS import permit applied for online, plus an endorsed health certificate.
lines: The US agriculture department page on Malaysian entry says a dog or cat must travel with a valid import permit from the Malaysian Quarantine and Inspection Services department (MAQIS) and an endorsed veterinary health certificate.
The permit application is made through the MAQIS online system, ePermit Dagangnet. Requirements for the animal itself are set out in the health certificate.
This is a US-side relay, so confirm with MAQIS before travel.
